description: This file contains the final class ReflectionCallable within the Twig\Util namespace, which provides reflection utilities for callables in Twig templates. It defines methods for analyzing and retrieving information about callables, including determining the reflection object, the callable itself, and a string name for identification. The class interacts with PHP reflection classes and handles various callable types such as strings, arrays, and closures.

classes.name: ReflectionCallable
classes.description: A utility class for reflecting on callables in Twig templates, providing methods to retrieve the reflector, the callable, and a human-readable name for the callable.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ReflectionCallable object by analyzing the provided TwigCallableInterface, determining the type of callable, and setting up reflection accordingly.

methods.name: getReflector
methods.description: Returns the reflection object (ReflectionFunction or ReflectionMethod) associated with the callable.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the name of the callable, suitable for debugging or display purposes.
